# Lupi

Lupi is a browser-based molecular viewer for students and people inspecting structure data.
Canonical site: https://lupi.live
Source: https://github.com/alexwelcing/Lupi
Publisher and content steward: Lupi product owner.
Publication version: student-surface-2026-09-04. Maintained in this repository, not mirrored from a research site.

## Human workflow
Explore the curated collection, open a model or local XYZ/LAMMPS file, inspect, learn, export, and optionally sign in to save a shareable view.
https://lupi.live/study/organic-functional-groups

## Molecule pages
Every curated small molecule has a zero-canvas page with its ink drawing, PubChem-backed identity, handbook values and a link into 3D: https://lupi.live/m/<id> (index: https://lupi.live/m/, list: https://lupi.live/m/manifest.json).
Share card: https://lupi.live/og/m/<id>.png (1200x630). Desk models: https://lupi.live/ar/<id>.usdz and .glb.

## OMol25 (Open Molecules 2025)
Meta FAIR Chemistry's DFT dataset (ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPD; Levine et al. 2025, arXiv:2505.08762; CC BY 4.0), paged one row at a time from the public ColabFit conversions on Hugging Face. Lupi stores no shards.
Browse: https://lupi.live/library/omol25 (the 34,335,828-row neutral training split; element filters over the 27,697-row neutral validation split).
Random structure: https://lupi.live/library/random
Featured picks (24 neutral-validation rows kept as same-origin copies, each with a sha256 receipt): https://lupi.live/datasets/omol25/featured.v1.json
One row as XYZ: https://lupi.live/v1/datasets/omol25/<collection>/structures/<row>.xyz. The comment line carries charge, spin multiplicity and where they came from.
Coordinates, charge and spin are source data. OMol25 supplies no bonds: the lines Lupi draws are its own inference (lupi-bonds.molecular.v1), solid for covalent bonds, dashed for metal coordination, dotted for ionic contacts.
Agents page the same rows with lupi.browse_collection and lupi.search_molecules.

## Agent interface
Edge manifest: https://lupi.live/mcp-manifest.json
Browser manifest: https://lupi.live/browser-mcp-manifest.json
These are different contracts. Edge V1 validates requests but does not render artifacts. Browser execution requires a mounted viewer.

## Boundaries
Inferred bonds (distance guides, or lupi-bonds.molecular.v1 on files that declare charge and spin) are not source bond topology. Unknown properties remain unknown.
Research execution and scientific claim publication belong to the separate Lupine Science project. They are not the student app.
